// Prints what TypeScript's `osq sync <id>` and `osq message <id>` give for
// each row of rust-land "Sync equals TypeScript's", "Active sync equals
// TypeScript's" and "Message equals TypeScript's".
// Run from the repository root after `pnpm build`, as an .mjs copy:
//   node print-sync-message-goldens.mjs <land change fixture> <golden folder>
// <land change fixture> is
// crates/features/land/tests/fixtures/land-change/001-alpha-orders.
//
// Each case builds a fresh scratch repository laid out as the land crate's
// `LandRepo` lays one out: `<scratch>/checkout` on `main` with `src/one.txt`
// holding `one\n` and `notes.txt` holding `notes\n`, committed as `initial`,
// and an untracked `osq.toml` holding the case's `[vcs]` table. A worktree
// change `<folder>` is a branch `osq/<folder>` cut from `main` with a worktree
// at `<scratch>/worktrees/<folder>`, whose one more commit, `work on
// <folder>`, writes `src/one.txt` holding `two\n` and its folder: the fixture
// copied to `openspec/changes/archive/001-alpha-orders`, or the case's files
// (the alpha change, the active change, or the files the case lists).
// Every git command runs with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and
// GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, and HOME is a fresh `<scratch>/home`. The command
// runs as `syncCommand` or `messageCommand` with `cwd` the checkout and the
// config `defineConfig` gives for the case's `vcs` table, stdout captured;
// stderr (the sync's progress line and the message's `Branch:` line) is not
// recorded. A case's `prepare` is written as `prepare = <JSON string>` under
// `[vcs]` too.
//
// The active change is `openspec/changes/001-alpha-orders` in the worktree
// with `proposal.md`, `.run/approved` holding `sha256:aaaa\n`, and four
// tasks, each `tasks/<n>.md` holding `---`, `title: Task <n>`,
// `verify: <verify>`, `scope:`, `  - <scope>`, `---`, `## Acceptance`, a blank
// line and `- [ ] Task <n> works.`. Task 1 (`echo one`, `src/**`) is done with
// a marker recording the scope hash of the branch's tree, task 2 (`echo two`,
// `src/one.txt`) is done with a manual marker, task 3 (`echo three`,
// `src/one.txt`) is done with a marker that records no scope hash, and task 4
// (`echo four`, `src/one.txt`) is pending. A case may replace a task's verify.
//
// Each golden row holds: `name`, `query`, `exit` (0, or 1 for a thrown
// `CommandError`), `stdout`, `error` (the `CommandError` message, or null),
// and for sync rows `tip` (the full message of `osq/<folder>`'s tip, as
// `git log -1 --format=%B` prints it), `status` (`git status --porcelain
// --untracked-files=all` in the worktree), `regressed`
// (whether the archived folder holds `.run/regressed/change.md`) and, when the
// case names one, `spec` (the worktree's `openspec/specs/orders/spec.md`).
// An active row also holds `changeEvents` and `taskEvents`, the lines the
// command added to the active folder's `.run/events/change.jsonl` and
// `.run/events/1.jsonl`, each parsed with its `timestamp` written as `<ts>`
// and a `data.duration` written as `<ms>`, and `done`, the worktree's
// `.run/done/1` with a `recertified_at` value written as `<ts>`.
// The worktree path is written as `<wt>`, the branch tip `osq/<folder>` had
// before the command as `<head>`, and a watcher record's pid as `<pid>`.
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';

process.env.GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL = '/dev/null';
process.env.GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM = '1';

const DIST = path.resolve('dist');
const { defineConfig } = await import(path.join(DIST, 'index.js'));
const { syncCommand } = await import(path.join(DIST, 'cli', 'sync.js'));
const { messageCommand } = await import(path.join(DIST, 'cli', 'message.js'));
const { computeTaskScopeHash } = await import(path.join(DIST, 'core', 'run', 'scope-hash.js'));
const { watchStateDir } = await import(path.join(DIST, 'core', 'run', 'watch-state.js'));

const [fixture, golden] = process.argv.slice(2);
const AUTHOR = 'osq <osq@example.invalid>';
const FIXTURE = '001-alpha-orders';
const ON = { enabled: true, author: AUTHOR };
const OFF = { enabled: false };

const PROPOSAL = '---\ntitle: A\n---\n## Verify\n\nx\n';
const ALPHA_DELTA =
  '## ADDED Requirements\n\n### Requirement: Alpha\nThe system SHALL alpha.\n\n#### Scenario: Alpha works\n- **WHEN** alpha\n- **THEN** alpha\n';

/** The orders spec with one requirement, as the land sync tests write it. */
function ordersSpec(name) {
  const lower = name.toLowerCase();
  return `# orders Specification\n\n## Purpose\n\nOrders.\n\n## Requirements\n\n### Requirement: ${name}\nThe system SHALL ${lower}.\n\n#### Scenario: ${name} works\n- **WHEN** ${lower}\n- **THEN** ${lower}\n`;
}

function git(cwd, args) {
  const run = spawnSync('git', args, { cwd, encoding: 'utf8' });
  if (run.status !== 0) throw new Error(`git ${args.join(' ')}: ${run.stderr}`);
  return run.stdout;
}

function write(dir, relative, text) {
  const target = path.join(dir, relative);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(target), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(target, text);
}

function vcsToml(vcs) {
  if (!vcs.enabled) return '[vcs]\nenabled = false\n';
  const prepare = vcs.prepare === undefined ? '' : `prepare = ${JSON.stringify(vcs.prepare)}\n`;
  return `[vcs]\nenabled = true\nauthor = "${AUTHOR}"\n${prepare}`;
}

function checkout(scratch, vcs) {
  const root = path.join(scratch, 'checkout');
  fs.mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
  git(root, ['init', '-q', '-b', 'main']);
  git(root, ['config', 'user.name', 'Osq Test']);
  git(root, ['config', 'user.email', 'osq@example.com']);
  git(root, ['config', 'commit.gpgSign', 'false']);
  write(root, 'src/one.txt', 'one\n');
  write(root, 'notes.txt', 'notes\n');
  git(root, ['add', '--', 'src/one.txt', 'notes.txt']);
  git(root, ['commit', '-q', '-m', 'initial']);
  write(root, 'osq.toml', vcsToml(vcs));
  return root;
}

/**
 * Adds a worktree change; `files` maps paths under the worktree to text, and
 * `before(tree)` writes more files after them, before the commit.
 */
async function worktreeChange(scratch, root, folder, files, before) {
  const tree = path.join(scratch, 'worktrees', folder);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(tree), { recursive: true });
  git(root, ['worktree', 'add', '-q', '-b', `osq/${folder}`, tree, 'main']);
  write(tree, 'src/one.txt', 'two\n');
  if (files === null) {
    fs.cpSync(fixture, path.join(tree, 'openspec', 'changes', 'archive', FIXTURE), {
      recursive: true,
    });
  } else {
    for (const [relative, text] of Object.entries(files)) write(tree, relative, text);
  }
  if (before) await before(tree);
  git(tree, ['add', '-A']);
  git(tree, ['commit', '-q', '-m', `work on ${folder}`]);
  return tree;
}

function mainCommit(root, relative, text, message) {
  write(root, relative, text);
  git(root, ['add', '--', relative]);
  git(root, ['commit', '-q', '-m', message]);
}

const archive = (folder, relative) => `openspec/changes/archive/${folder}/${relative}`;
const active = (relative) => `openspec/changes/${FIXTURE}/${relative}`;

// The alpha change: an archived change whose delta adds `Alpha` to `orders`,
// with the living spec archive wrote on its branch.
const ALPHA_CHANGE = {
  [archive(FIXTURE, 'proposal.md')]: PROPOSAL,
  [archive(FIXTURE, 'specs/orders/spec.md')]: ALPHA_DELTA,
  'openspec/specs/orders/spec.md': ordersSpec('Alpha'),
};

/** One task file of the active change. */
function taskFile(n, verify, scope) {
  return `---\ntitle: Task ${n}\nverify: ${verify}\nscope:\n  - ${scope}\n---\n## Acceptance\n\n- [ ] Task ${n} works.\n`;
}

const ACTIVE_VERIFIES = { 1: 'echo one', 2: 'echo two', 3: 'echo three', 4: 'echo four' };
const ACTIVE_SCOPES = { 1: 'src/**', 2: 'src/one.txt', 3: 'src/one.txt', 4: 'src/one.txt' };

/** The active change's files, with `verifies` replacing task verifies. */
function activeChange(verifies = {}, extra = {}) {
  const files = {
    [active('proposal.md')]: '---\ntitle: A\nverify: echo change\n---\n## Verify\n\nx\n',
    [active('.run/approved')]: 'sha256:aaaa\n',
    [active('.run/done/2')]: '---\nmanual: true\n---\n2026-10-20T08:00:00.000Z\n',
    [active('.run/done/3')]: '---\nverified_by: watcher\n---\n2026-10-20T08:00:00.000Z\n',
    ...extra,
  };
  for (const n of [1, 2, 3, 4]) {
    files[active(`tasks/${n}.md`)] = taskFile(n, verifies[n] ?? ACTIVE_VERIFIES[n], ACTIVE_SCOPES[n]);
  }
  return files;
}

/** Writes task 1's done marker with the scope hash of the tree as it is. */
async function markTaskOneDone(tree) {
  const hash = await computeTaskScopeHash(tree, [ACTIVE_SCOPES[1]]);
  const files = Object.entries(hash.fileHashes)
    .map(([file, value]) => `  ${file}: ${value}\n`)
    .join('');
  write(
    tree,
    active('.run/done/1'),
    `---\nscope_hash: ${hash.hash}\nscope_files:\n${files}scope_resolver: 2\n---\n2026-10-20T08:00:00.000Z\n`,
  );
}

/** Writes a live watcher record for the checkout under the case's HOME. */
async function liveWatcher(root, home) {
  const dir = await watchStateDir(root, home);
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(
    path.join(dir, 'watcher.json'),
    `${JSON.stringify({ pid: process.pid, mode: 'terminal', version: '0.3.0', commit: 'abc1234', startedAt: '2026-10-24T08:00:00.000Z', waiting: null })}\n`,
  );
}

const syncCases = [
  {
    name: 'clean-001',
    query: '1',
    files: ALPHA_CHANGE,
    setup(root, tree) {
      mainCommit(root, 'other.txt', 'other\n', 'main adds other');
    },
  },
  { name: 'current-001', query: '1', setup() {} },
  {
    name: 'spec-conflict-001',
    query: '1',
    files: ALPHA_CHANGE,
    spec: true,
    setup(root) {
      mainCommit(root, 'openspec/specs/orders/spec.md', ordersSpec('Beta'), 'main adds beta');
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'code-conflict-001',
    query: '1',
    setup(root) {
      mainCommit(root, 'src/one.txt', 'main\n', 'main edits one');
    },
  },
  { name: 'vcs-off-001', query: '1', vcs: OFF, setup() {} },
  {
    name: 'dirty-001',
    query: '1',
    setup(root, tree) {
      write(tree, 'notes.txt', 'dirty\n');
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'run-dirt-001',
    query: '001',
    files: ALPHA_CHANGE,
    setup(root, tree) {
      write(tree, archive(FIXTURE, '.run/extra'), 'extra\n');
      mainCommit(root, 'other.txt', 'other\n', 'main adds other');
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'renamed-001',
    query: '1',
    setup(root, tree) {
      git(tree, ['mv', 'notes.txt', 'moved.txt']);
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'tasks-dirt-001',
    query: '1',
    files: ALPHA_CHANGE,
    setup(root, tree) {
      write(tree, archive(FIXTURE, 'tasks.md'), '# Tasks\n');
      mainCommit(root, 'other.txt', 'other\n', 'main adds other');
    },
  },
  { name: 'missing-2', query: '2', setup() {} },
  {
    name: 'watcher-archived-001',
    query: '1',
    async setup(root, tree, home) {
      await liveWatcher(root, home);
      mainCommit(root, 'other.txt', 'other\n', 'main adds other');
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'active-recert-001',
    query: '1',
    activeRow: true,
    files: activeChange(),
    before: markTaskOneDone,
    setup(root) {
      mainCommit(root, 'src/three.txt', 'three\n', 'main adds three');
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'active-clean-001',
    query: '001',
    activeRow: true,
    files: activeChange(),
    before: markTaskOneDone,
    setup(root) {
      mainCommit(root, 'other.txt', 'other\n', 'main adds other');
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'active-current-001',
    query: '1',
    activeRow: true,
    files: activeChange(),
    before: markTaskOneDone,
    setup() {},
  },
  {
    name: 'active-red-001',
    query: '1',
    activeRow: true,
    files: activeChange({ 3: 'echo broken; exit 1' }),
    before: markTaskOneDone,
    setup(root) {
      mainCommit(root, 'src/three.txt', 'three\n', 'main adds three');
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'active-code-conflict-001',
    query: '1',
    activeRow: true,
    files: activeChange(),
    before: markTaskOneDone,
    setup(root) {
      mainCommit(root, 'src/one.txt', 'main\n', 'main edits one');
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'active-spec-001',
    query: '1',
    activeRow: true,
    spec: true,
    files: activeChange({}, { [active('specs/orders/spec.md')]: ALPHA_DELTA }),
    before: markTaskOneDone,
    setup(root) {
      mainCommit(root, 'openspec/specs/orders/spec.md', ordersSpec('Beta'), 'main adds beta');
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'active-running-001',
    query: '1',
    activeRow: true,
    files: activeChange(),
    before: markTaskOneDone,
    setup(root, tree) {
      write(tree, active('.run/running/4.pid'), '{"pid":1,"startedAt":1}\n');
      mainCommit(root, 'other.txt', 'other\n', 'main adds other');
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'active-dirty-001',
    query: '1',
    activeRow: true,
    files: activeChange(),
    before: markTaskOneDone,
    setup(root, tree) {
      write(tree, active('tasks.md'), '# Tasks\n');
      write(tree, active('.run/extra'), 'extra\n');
      write(tree, 'notes.txt', 'dirty\n');
      mainCommit(root, 'other.txt', 'other\n', 'main adds other');
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'active-prepare-001',
    query: '1',
    activeRow: true,
    vcs: { ...ON, prepare: 'echo nope; exit 1' },
    files: activeChange(),
    before: markTaskOneDone,
    setup(root) {
      mainCommit(root, 'other.txt', 'other\n', 'main adds other');
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'active-unapproved-001',
    query: '1',
    files: { [active('proposal.md')]: PROPOSAL },
    setup(root) {
      mainCommit(root, 'other.txt', 'other\n', 'main adds other');
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'active-watcher-001',
    query: '1',
    activeRow: true,
    files: activeChange(),
    before: markTaskOneDone,
    async setup(root, tree, home) {
      await liveWatcher(root, home);
      mainCommit(root, 'other.txt', 'other\n', 'main adds other');
    },
  },
];

const messageCases = [
  { name: 'fixture-001', query: '1' },
  { name: 'bare-001', query: '001', folder: '001', files: { [archive('001', 'proposal.md')]: PROPOSAL } },
  { name: 'vcs-off-001', query: '1', vcs: OFF },
  {
    name: 'active-001',
    query: '1',
    files: {
      [`openspec/changes/${FIXTURE}/proposal.md`]: '---\ntitle: A\n---\n',
      [`openspec/changes/${FIXTURE}/.run/approved`]: 'sha256:aaaa\n',
    },
  },
  { name: 'missing-2', query: '2' },
];

async function capture(run) {
  let stdout = '';
  try {
    await run({ stdout: (text) => (stdout += text), stderr: () => {} });
    return { exit: 0, stdout, error: null };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error?.name !== 'CommandError') throw error;
    return { exit: error.exitCode, stdout, error: error.message };
  }
}

function scratchFolder() {
  return fs.realpathSync(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'osq-sync-message-')));
}

function placeholders(text, tree, head) {
  if (typeof text !== 'string') return text;
  let out = text;
  if (tree !== null) out = out.split(tree).join('<wt>');
  if (head !== null) out = out.split(head).join('<head>');
  return out.split(`pid ${process.pid}`).join('pid <pid>');
}

function readText(file) {
  return fs.existsSync(file) ? fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8') : '';
}

/** The lines `after` adds to `before`, parsed, with run-specific values replaced. */
function addedEvents(before, after, tree) {
  return after
    .slice(before.length)
    .split('\n')
    .filter((line) => line.trim() !== '')
    .map((line) => {
      const event = JSON.parse(placeholders(line, tree, null));
      event.timestamp = '<ts>';
      if (event.data && typeof event.data.duration === 'number') event.data.duration = '<ms>';
      return event;
    });
}

const syncRows = [];
for (const c of syncCases) {
  const scratch = scratchFolder();
  const home = path.join(scratch, 'home');
  fs.mkdirSync(home, { recursive: true });
  process.env.HOME = home;
  const vcs = c.vcs ?? ON;
  const root = checkout(scratch, vcs);
  const folder = FIXTURE;
  const tree = await worktreeChange(scratch, root, folder, c.files ?? null, c.before);
  await c.setup(root, tree, home);
  const head = git(root, ['rev-parse', `osq/${folder}`]).trim();
  const changeEventsPath = path.join(tree, active('.run/events/change.jsonl'));
  const taskEventsPath = path.join(tree, active('.run/events/1.jsonl'));
  const changeBefore = readText(changeEventsPath);
  const taskBefore = readText(taskEventsPath);
  const config = defineConfig({ vcs });
  const result = await capture((io) => syncCommand(c.query, { cwd: root, config, ...io }));
  const row = {
    name: c.name,
    query: c.query,
    ...result,
    tip: git(root, ['log', '-1', '--format=%B', `osq/${folder}`]),
    status: git(tree, ['status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all']),
    regressed: fs.existsSync(path.join(tree, archive(folder, '.run/regressed/change.md'))),
  };
  if (c.spec) row.spec = fs.readFileSync(path.join(tree, 'openspec/specs/orders/spec.md'), 'utf8');
  if (c.activeRow) {
    row.changeEvents = addedEvents(changeBefore, readText(changeEventsPath), tree);
    row.taskEvents = addedEvents(taskBefore, readText(taskEventsPath), tree);
    row.done = readText(path.join(tree, active('.run/done/1'))).replace(
      /^recertified_at: .*$/m,
      'recertified_at: <ts>',
    );
  }
  for (const key of ['stdout', 'error', 'tip', 'status']) row[key] = placeholders(row[key], tree, head);
  syncRows.push(row);
  fs.rmSync(scratch, { recursive: true, force: true });
}

const messageRows = [];
for (const c of messageCases) {
  const scratch = scratchFolder();
  const home = path.join(scratch, 'home');
  fs.mkdirSync(home, { recursive: true });
  process.env.HOME = home;
  const vcs = c.vcs ?? ON;
  const root = checkout(scratch, vcs);
  const folder = c.folder ?? FIXTURE;
  const tree = await worktreeChange(scratch, root, folder, c.files ?? null);
  const head = git(root, ['rev-parse', `osq/${folder}`]).trim();
  const config = defineConfig({ vcs });
  const result = await capture((io) => messageCommand(c.query, { cwd: root, config, ...io }));
  const row = { name: c.name, query: c.query, ...result };
  for (const key of ['stdout', 'error']) row[key] = placeholders(row[key], tree, head);
  messageRows.push(row);
  fs.rmSync(scratch, { recursive: true, force: true });
}

fs.writeFileSync(path.join(golden, 'sync.json'), `${JSON.stringify(syncRows, null, 2)}\n`);
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(golden, 'message.json'), `${JSON.stringify(messageRows, null, 2)}\n`);
